Voice of America. "India Makes Historic Moon Landing Near Lunar South Pole". Published August 23, 2023. The article states that India successfully placed a lander in the moon's southern polar region on August 23, 2023, making it the first country to touch down on this uncharted part of the lunar surface. [1]
PBS. "India becomes fourth country to land on the moon, first to reach south pole". Published August 23, 2023. This source confirms that India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down near this little-explored region. [2]
The Guardian. "India becomes first country to land spacecraft on moon’s south pole". Published August 22, 2023. The Guardian reports that India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon, with the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft's Vikram lander touching down shortly after 6 pm (1230 BST) on August 23, 2023. [3]
Astronomy.com. "India is the fourth country to land on the Moon, but the first to reach the south pole". Published August 24, 2023. This article states that on August 23, 2023, the Indian Space Research Organization's (ISRO) Chandrayaan-3 mission landed near the Moon's south pole, making India the first country to land in that region. [4]
Wikipedia. "Chandrayaan-3". Last updated October 7, 2026. Wikipedia states that Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC), making ISRO the first in human history to achieve a soft landing near the lunar south pole. [5]
The Hindu. "Chandrayaan-3 lander generated ‘ejecta halo’ on lunar surface: ISRO". Published October 27, 2023. The Hindu reports that Chandrayaan-3's lander module, Vikram, made its historic touchdown on the south pole of the moon on August 23, 2023. [6]
